description: This file declares the `NetUtils` class within the `WPEFramework::Plugin` namespace, providing utility functions related to network interfaces, IP address validation, command execution, and file operations. It also includes macro definitions and external file includes relevant to network utilities.
external_methods: IN_IS_ADDR_LINKLOCAL macro (defined here, but used for address checks)

classes.name: NetUtils
classes.description: A utility class for network-related operations, including interface description retrieval, IP validation, command execution, and file management.

methods.name: InitialiseNetUtils
methods.description: Initializes network utilities, possibly loading interface descriptions.

methods.name: getInterfaceDescription
methods.description: Retrieves description for a network interface given its name.

methods.name: isIPV4
methods.description: Checks if the provided address string is a valid IPv4 address.

methods.name: isIPV6
methods.description: Checks if the provided address string is a valid IPv6 address.

methods.name: isIPV6LinkLocal
methods.description: Checks if the provided IPv6 address is link-local.

methods.name: isIPV4LinkLocal
methods.description: Checks if the provided IPv4 address is link-local.

methods.name: execCmd
methods.description: Executes a command in the shell and captures the output.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Reads the contents of a file into a string.

methods.name: getTmpFilename
methods.description: Generates a temporary filename based on input.

methods.name: isValidEndpointURL
methods.description: Validates if a given URL is a properly formed endpoint URL.
